text:
support_jamal: FYI escalation from 2 enterprise customers (Acme & Flowly). After last night's rollout of rwd-llama-3-70b-q8_v1 they see major factual hallucinations in summarization flow. Customers supplied before/after examples. I'm opening this thread to coordinate rollback/hotfix.

deploy-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-315 — model-quality-regression (priority=high)

support_jamal: Repro steps (from customer):
1) POST /v1/generate with model=rwd-llama-3-70b-q8_v1
2) prompt: "Summarize the contract clause and list obligations"
3) params: {"max_tokens":256, "temperature":0.0}

Returned: confidently wrong dates and invented clause names. Attached customer snippets in ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-315

sre_maya: Seen the alert from eval pipeline this morning — automatic regression detectors tripped on canary set. Canary rollout was at 10% yesterday then pushed to 100% at 02:14 UTC. Telemetry shows drop in ROUGE/factuality by ~22% for the contract prompt suite.

devin_prod: Confirming. Perf/latency fine, but semantic QA scores dropped. I pulled logs — there was a compiler-kernel change in runtime v2.14 used for this model variant (quantized execution path) that landed in the last deploy.

infra_alex: If this is a serving/runtime regression we should rollback model traffic immediately. Two mitigation options:
- rollback model traffic to previous model version rwd-llama-3-70b-q8_v0
- if that's not possible, force routing to cpu/legacy path for the model (higher cost, less perf)

lia_pm: Customers want a timeline and mitigation ASAP. If we rollback, we'll tell them we reverted to previous model version and are investigating.

sre_maya: I'm ready to execute rollback. Suggest command:
```
rwdctl rollout set --model rwd-llama-3-70b --version rwd-llama-3-70b-q8_v0 --traffic 100
```
That should flip traffic back to v0. Can someone confirm cluster capacity for v0 at 100%?

infra_alex: Cluster capacity check: v0 is already cached on nodes and has previously run at full traffic. We have headroom for a temporary reroute. I'll RSVP when we start draining the new model instances.

devin_prod: Before rollback, quick sanity check: is there any dataset mismatch (tokenizer differences) between v0 and v1? I compared tokenizer hashes — they match. So likely runtime/quantization kernel.

support_jamal: Customers asked for a hotfix window. If we rollback, please note in ticket and send a short customer update. I'll craft a message once rollback is confirmed.

sre_maya: Rolling back in 2 min. @infra_alex please watch node drains, @devin_prod watch eval metrics.

infra_alex: Starting rollback now.

oncall-bot: Deploy event: rollback-started by sre_maya at 2026-03-15T14:10:12Z

infra_alex: Draining v1 instances... 0 -> 100% traffic to v0 in progress.

deploy-bot: Rollout status: 50% traffic switched. Watch eval pipeline: https://observability.redwood/telemetry/rollouts/1752012345

devin_prod: Eval queue showing improvement on the canary suite already. Factuality metric is trending up (partial). No errors in runtime logs yet.

infra_alex: Rollback complete. Traffic is at 100% v0.

oncall-bot: Deploy event: rollback-complete by infra_alex at 2026-03-15T14:17:00Z

sre_maya: Post-rollback checks:
- quick-run contract prompt suite -> outputs match pre-rollout baselines
- latency within SLO
- no increase in error rates

devin_prod: Great. Marking this as mitigated for customer-facing communications. I'll open a short postmortem draft. Initial hypothesis: change in quantized kernel in runtime v2.14 + model variant q8_v1 exposes numerical edge case causing factuality regressions.

lia_pm: Customer update (to send in support ticket): "We've reverted the model to the previous version and are investigating root cause. You should see behavior restored. We'll follow up with a technical update and ETA for a safe re-release." I'll post it after Jamal approves.

support_jamal: Approved. Sending update now. Please add a note to the incident ticket with the exact rollback commands and timestamps.

devin_prod: I'll trace the runtime diff and prepare a patch plan. Priorities: reproduce locally with same quantization pipeline, add additional test cases to the canary suite covering contract/legal prompts, and block auto-promotion until we have a fix.

infra_alex: Also adding a temporary gating rule: new model variants with quantization changes require a 24h canary at 10% and manual signoff from infra+ml before 100%.

sre_maya: Agreed. For now, closing the high-urgency mitigation. We'll keep this incident open for root-cause and postmortem items.

support_jamal: Customers confirmed restored behavior. They appreciate the quick rollback. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Incident INC-2026-315 status: mitigated -> investigating

devin_prod: I'll attach repro script and logs to the ticket. Quick repro command for the team:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-llama-3-70b-q8_v1","prompt":"Summarize the contract clause...","max_tokens":256,"temperature":0.0}'
```

lia_pm: Next steps owner list:
- devin_prod: root cause & patch timeline
- infra_alex + sre_maya: gating rule + rollback playbook updates
- support_jamal: customer communications

sre_maya: Thanks everyone. If new customer reports come in, flag them here and we'll reopen immediate action.

support_jamal: Will do. Closing thread for active rollback coordination. Follow-up postmortem ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-2026-315?focusedCommentId=10001

oncall-bot: Reminder: Please file a postmortem within 72h per runbook.
